indicators.label: Resident population
indicators.description: Resident population as reported in the corresponding ARDA county file and used as the denominator for adherents per 100 population.
indicators.method: Read from each wave's same-study county population field.
indicators.spatial_coverage: US counties, joined to the 2020 boundary set where a defensible FIPS join or crosswalk exists.
indicators.quality_notes: The population denominator comes from the same ARDA study file as the adherent count; no external population splicing is used.

indicators.label: Adherents per 100 population
indicators.description: Congregational adherents reported to ARDA / the U.S. Religion Census per 100 residents. This is institutional adherence claimed by participating religious bodies, not census self-identification.
indicators.method: 100 * total adherents (or members in 1952) divided by same-study county population.
indicators.quality_notes: Religious-body participation and definitions differ by wave. The 1952 file has only a Negro Missions estimate, the 1971 file covers 53 denominations, the 1980 and 1990 files include partial Black-denomination coverage, and the 2000 file excludes historically African-American denominations.

indicators.label: Change in adherents per 100 population
indicators.description: Wave-to-wave percentage-point change in adherents per 100 population.
indicators.method: Later wave adherents-per-100 minus the previous available wave's adherents-per-100 for the same 2020 county.
indicators.quality_notes: Treat wave-to-wave change as directional. Source coverage, definitions, and county-boundary crosswalks differ across the historical sequence.

header.data_status_note: County-level adherents/members and congregations are live for qualifying ARDA waves from 1952 through 2020. Federal Census of Religious Bodies county files from 1906 through 1936 are not included because they lack same-study county population fields.
